purpose: Harden Equipment frontend display and list-state behavior without reopening Stage 3 semantics, Stage B ownership, routing, or admission.

general.sanitize: tab must be 1/2/3; group must exist in generated filters; subtype must exist under the sanitized active group; incompatible/unknown values become null/default.
general.writeGuard: Do not write default state until the restore attempt has completed.
general.storageFailure: Malformed JSON, unavailable storage, or write failure is non-fatal and falls back to safe defaults/current in-memory state.
general.groupChange: Changing or clearing group clears subtype.
general.tabChange: Changing tab preserves the selected equipment-type filter; an empty result is handled by the list empty-state reset action.
general.detailReturn: Returning from /equipment/$equipmentId to /equipment restores the persisted tab/group/subtype state.

exclusive.sanitize: group must exist in the generated exclusive filters; subtype must exist under the sanitized active group; incompatible/unknown values become null.
exclusive.writeGuard: Do not write default state until the restore attempt has completed.
exclusive.storageFailure: Malformed JSON, unavailable storage, or write failure is non-fatal and falls back to safe defaults/current in-memory state.
exclusive.groupChange: Changing or clearing group clears subtype.
exclusive.detailReturn: Returning from /equipment/$equipmentId to /equipment/exclusive restores the persisted group/subtype state.

statePolicy.isolation: General and exclusive lists use separate versioned storage keys; state must not leak between list modes.

nameFallback.rule: A nameCn fallback is presentation only and never upgrades REVIEW metadata.

generalOrderMessaging.tab1: Presentation order only; do not claim exact historical release chronology.
generalOrderMessaging.tab2: Verified release-group ordering may be reflected, but exact order inside an equal release group is not claimed.
generalOrderMessaging.tab3: REVIEW_RELEASE_ORDER; current order must not be described as latest or exact release chronology.

displayPolicy.exclusiveOrderMessaging: Exclusive chronology remains REVIEW; deterministic generated order is presentation-only.
displayPolicy.effect: Continue displaying frozen Stage 3 effect text/segments without semantic rewrite.
displayPolicy.restriction: Continue displaying structural-inference semantics at confidence 0.99 without claiming direct runtime proof.
displayPolicy.emptyState: Both list routes provide an explicit empty state with a filter-reset action; general reset preserves the active tab and exclusive reset clears group/subtype.
